en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue bordered by brick residential buildings. A boxy delivery truck and several horse‑drawn carts travel down the cobbled street, while a cyclist stands with a bicycle in the foreground on the right. The architecture is early 20th‑century European, with bay windows and tiled roofs. In the lower‑left corner, there is a printed caption identifying the view as a street in Nijmegen.
